review_model_provenance: Astra parent dispatch, as confirmed by user; not inferred from assistant persona.

method.visual_inspection: Source and both chronological contact sheets inspected with view_image.
method.decode: CPU only; ffmpeg -hwaccel none; decoder/output threads 2; filter_threads and filter_complex_threads 1; sequential extraction.

scope: Exact-hash source/video visual reward gate only; no processing or integration approval.
limitations: 32 sampled frames cannot guarantee absence of every inter-sample artifact, frame-perfect smoothness, or seamless looping.
observations: Golden acorn retains its brown textured cap and short brown stem as it gently rocks. Cap stays attached throughout all 32 samples, with no splitting, vanishing or replacement.

Both the green rear oak leaf and large orange oak leaf remain present with recognizable lobes and veins while fluttering softly. Purple mushroom retains pink spots and cream stalk; turquoise ground patch stays present.
Motion is gentle and coherent, source colors/layout are retained, and all acorn/leaf/mushroom components remain within the frame. No faces, eyes, mouths, limbs or disappearing parts appear.
